body.name: Observable selectedness-certificate closure
body.construction: Let \(C^{(0)}(\mathcal O)\subseteq V\) contain both observed endpoints of every observed--observed adjacency that is absent from the observational skeleton \(H\) and present in at least one intervention-regime skeleton in \(\mathcal O\). Recursively, let \(C^{(r+1)}(\mathcal O)\) equal \(C^{(r)}(\mathcal O)\) together with every middle vertex \(x\) of an observational unshielded noncollider \(i-x-j\) whose nonadjacent endpoints \(i,j\) lie in \(C^{(r)}(\mathcal O)\). Define \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)=\bigcup_{r=0}^{|V|}C^{(r)}(\mathcal O)\), \(L_{\mathrm{cert}}(\mathcal O)=(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O),\{x\to y:xy\in H[\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)],\ \sigma(x)\subseteq\sigma(y)\})\), and let \(\operatorname{Reach}_{\mathrm{cert},\mathcal O}\) be nonempty directed reachability in this graph. Every ingredient is computed from \(\mathcal O\); no compatible model or latent set \(A(\eta)\) is queried.
